retained_failures: The first development probe indexed proposal and decision_documents as required result keys. Request-evidence results omit proposal, and the decision surface reports decision_document_fields; the corrected probe uses proposal.get semantics and proves metadata-only stale projection with zero payload characters.
The first focused unittest command named two nonexistent test methods. The exact corrected MCP, HTTP/dashboard, and condition/outcome metric test names pass without running the new held-out behavior.

units.purpose: Run all prior source, package, API, MCP, state, telemetry, dashboard, reproducibility, and clean-clone gates on the frozen candidate.
outputs: source and package evaluation and real-surface evidence
retained_failures: The first public-seal candidate gate passed all static validators but stopped before evaluation when the exhaustive exact-outcome unit fixture still enumerated the 42 pre-change scenarios. The runtime catalog and frozen terminal contract already contained the two exact successor cases. The fixture-only correction adds those IDs and expected outcomes; no candidate artifact or held-out runtime result was produced.
A PowerShell preflight used -replace inside an array without grouping and stopped before creating either final evaluation. The corrected command used explicit source and package trace variables.

A compact post-evaluation reporter attempted to parse JSONL trace files as single JSON documents after both source and package evaluations had already passed and been independently trace-verified. The corrected reporter handled report and trace types separately.

A credential-scan reporting wrapper reused PowerShell's special $Matches variable and failed during serialization; the corrected task-specific variables reported only package-contract scanner definitions and zero remaining high-signal files.
A living-record inventory guessed docs/architecture-decisions.md before locating the actual docs/adr directory. No record was changed by the failed lookup.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Local and remote-only clean-clone source, package, real-surface, reproducibility, parsing, scan, and rendered-dashboard gates all pass.
